Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry
Apply - Graduate StudentsApply - Undergraduate Students
The Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry is committed to providing high quality
education in the chemical and biochemical sciences for undergraduate and graduate
students, producing research contributions that are recognized nationally and internationally
to benefit society.
Analytical
Enabling cutting edge chemical analysis via development of instrumentation and methods,
and furthering their fundamental understanding.
Explore Division
Biochemistry
Employing a variety of research tools to study biolgical molecules including genes
proteins enzymes, lipids, and metabolites.
Explore Division
Inorganic
Using the broad ranging properties of the inorganic elements to tailor the properties
of new molecules and materials.
Explore Division
Organic
Using organic compounds as a scaffold for conducting novel reactions, catalysis,
investigating chirality, and achieving new properties in molecules and materials.
Explore Division
Physical and Theoretical
Looking "under the hood" at the fundamental physical processes that give rise to
the properties and reactivities of matter.
